merge_policy: Source and housekeeping changes execute hosted source checks without acquiring the installed host. Native/build inputs additionally execute both hosted native profiles. Runtime changes execute their selected PostgreSQL/custom-stack/package checks before main deployment. Installed source-corpus acceptance is selected by its actual engine, admission, dependency, package and source inputs or explicitly dispatched; unrelated changes do not redeploy or reingest content. Skipped work is reported as not selected, never as executed proof.
purpose: Select validation, build, deployment and installed acceptance by their actual source inputs, with one owner for each decision.

evidence.meaning: hosted source requirements and contract checks, with both native profiles only when requires_hosted_native is true; unselected native profiles are not execution evidence
laplace-runner oneAPI PostgreSQL native managed and source-estate integration proof

exact current-change product package executed as an isolated PostgreSQL 18.6 cluster with live required-object inode and digest proof, fresh Laplace schema and epoch-state readback, and durable BLAKE3 receipts; this merge proof is not product activation

exact current-change product package composition, isolated immutable installation and replay verification, with raw package and installation receipt bytes retained in the persistent laplace-runner BLAKE3 receipt store

fail_closed.unknown_path: Treat as product-semantic and require hosted plus custom-stack evidence.
fail_closed.missing_provider: Fail product-path; an unimplemented required evidence provider cannot be interpreted as skipped success.
fail_closed.runner_unavailable: Remain queued or fail; physical runner loss cannot produce green semantic evidence.
